Which data, why, and where it goes.
Novila gives general advice, not medical advice. Ask a doctor or physiotherapist if you are unsure.
Everything you log is saved on this phone only. Novila has no account and no cloud, so nothing can be restored once deleted.
Your profile and goals, your logged sleep, food, mood and workouts and the coach\'s answers are deleted from this phone. This cannot be undone. Data in Health Connect is not affected.
No ads, no analytics and no network calls. Your health data stays on the phone.
Hanken Grotesk typeface, SIL Open Font License 1.1. Icons from Material Symbols, Apache License 2.0.
Novila gives general advice on exercise, sleep and food. It is not a medical device, and it does not diagnose, treat or prevent any disease.
Talk to a doctor or physiotherapist before you start training if you have an illness, an injury or pain, are pregnant, or are unsure whether training suits you.
Stop and rest if you feel chest pain, dizziness, shortness of breath or sharp pain. Seek care if it does not pass. In an emergency, call 112.
The coach\'s gentle training programs are general and do not replace a plan from your physiotherapist. Follow the pain limit, and your caregiver\'s advice before Novila\'s.
The coach\'s comment is written by Gemini Nano on your phone. AI can be wrong. The program itself is made without AI, and it is what counts.
Activity goals follow the WHO\'s physical activity guidelines, and the nutrition score follows the Swedish Food Agency\'s dietary guidelines. Your own needs can differ.

Every field is optional. Your profile is saved on this phone only and needs no account. Deleting all data under Settings deletes it too.
A tour of Novila, and your goal and time for the coach.
From your profile: %1$s steps, %2$s of sleep and %3$d glasses of water a day.
Add your birth year or weight to your profile, and Novila suggests goals that fit you.
Today, Sleep and Nutrition measure your days against these goals. Water counts towards the nutrition score; the food portions follow the Swedish Food Agency\'s dietary advice. A glass is 2 dl.
Only about what you haven\'t logged yet
Novila only reminds you about what you haven\'t logged yet, and only on the days it matters. Reminders come as notifications; the first time, your phone asks whether Novila may show them.
Novila isn\'t allowed to show notifications, so your reminders won\'t appear. Turn them on in your phone\'s settings.
In the morning, if last night isn\'t logged.
On days with a session in your program, if you haven\'t trained yet.
